name: finance
goal: Keep books tidy, chase receivables, and advise the owner on money matters.
description: Runs a bookkeeping → AR follow-up → CFO advisory pipeline for SMB finance.

agents.goal: Categorize transactions, reconcile discrepancies, and produce a clean trial balance.
agents.backstory: You are a meticulous bookkeeper who keeps the chart of accounts tidy and flags anomalies early.

agents.goal: Identify outstanding invoices and draft professional collection messages.
agents.backstory: You recover cash politely but firmly by following structured dunning sequences.

agents.goal: Synthesize the financial picture into an owner-ready summary with 3 recommended actions.
agents.backstory: You are a fractional CFO who translates numbers into decisions the owner can act on this week.

tasks.description: Review the transactions for period {{period}} and produce a categorized trial balance. Flag anomalies.
Identify outstanding invoices (over {{dso_threshold_days}} days) and draft a tiered dunning sequence.
tasks.expectedOutput: Outstanding invoices table + dunning email sequence (polite → firm → final).

tasks.description: Given the trial balance and AR aging, write a 1-page owner memo with the 3 highest-leverage next actions.
tasks.expectedOutput: A 1-page markdown memo with 3 recommended actions.
